why: Reports a successful patch when the field was not found on that profile. The sweep compares this count against the one it took before the run and refuses a mismatch, so a truthful 0 stops the run; a fabricated 1 lets it proceed and measure the SHIPPED value under the label it meant to set. That is the dead-knob failure this whole tool is built to make impossible -- its header says so in its first paragraph.
